newsitem.title: USA: CTG considers refiling normalization plan.
newsitem.headline: CTG considers refiling normalization plan.

text.p: Connecticut Natural Gas Corp said Wednesday it will consider refiling its request to institute a Weather Normalization Adjustment (WNA) with the Department of Public Utility Control, which determined it would not consider the the request.
Such an adjustment would have the effect of equalizing the CTG Resources Inc subsidiary's margins on gas sales during the winter heating months.

"We are disappointed that the (department) did not favorably consider our request for a WNA at this time. The company will consider refiling its request following further internal analysis and review. CNG will also provide the DPUC with additional information as part of any potential filing."
